issues: Integrity is fine. No file or network access and no pasted answers. The PLS features are built from training labels only: out-of-fold for the training rows, and a fit on the full training fold for the test rows. Test labels are never used.

There is no bug that would make the result meaningless. One weakness affects quality only: the 8 PLS components from the 5 inner-fold fits may not line up with each other or with the full fit, since later components can rotate. The training and test PLS features also come from slightly different models. Both of these can only hurt the candidate, so they don't inflate the score.

Recomputed z = (0.3655 - 0.3695) / (0.0037 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) ≈ -0.88. This is close to the harness value of -0.867; the gap is likely rounding of the means. The candidate is slightly worse than the incumbent, so reject is the right decision.
The candidate also adds about 10 lines of stacking code without a measured gain, which goes against 'simpler is better'.
